In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="Slaves of the Republic Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] undertook an undercover '''mission to Zygerria''' to rescue the [[Togruta/Legends|Togrutan]] population of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] from [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]].
